morphology.pattern_note: 此词采用 mem-，并保留词根开头的 p；按马来西亚词典所收形式记忆。输入包将整个派生词标为词根，此处依据实际构词关系更正。

senses.zh_definition: 深深吸引，使倾心或赞叹；具有令人着迷的感染力。
senses.en_definition: To captivate or fascinate; to attract someone's attention or admiration strongly.
senses.ms_definition: Memikat hati atau menarik perhatian seseorang dengan sangat kuat.
senses.nuances: 常用于声音、表演、景色或人的风采，语气比 menarik 更强，也稍具文学色彩。修饰名词时常用 yang mempesona；表达体验者着迷则用 terpesona。[DBP：mempesona](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=Mempesona)

senses.zh_definition: 对某人施加迷魂术或巫术。
senses.en_definition: To put someone under a magical spell; to bewitch.
senses.nuances: 这是涉及巫术的字面义，主要见于民间故事或相关叙述。下列搭配为义项示例，不代表已核实的高频搭配。[DBP：《Kamus Pelajar》义项](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=Mempesona)

collocations.zh: 以咒语对某人施迷魂术
collocations.en: to bewitch someone with an incantation
to put a victim under a spell

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Persembahan kebudayaan itu berjaya mempesona para tetamu antarabangsa.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这场文化表演成功打动了国际来宾。
dual_scenarios.en: The cultural performance captivated the international guests.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Suara dia memang mempesona lah, aku nak dengar lagi.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Suaranya memang mempesona; saya mahu mendengarnya lagi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 他的声音真的太迷人了，我还想听。
dual_scenarios.en: Their voice is so captivating. I want to hear more.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah dengar lagu baru dia. Suara dia memang mempesona lah.
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah mendengar lagu baharunya. Suaranya memang mempesona.
messages.zh: 我听过他的新歌了，声音真的很迷人。
messages.en: I've heard their new song. Their voice is really captivating.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kan? Aku nak dengar sekali lagi je sebelum tidur.
messages.ms_standard: Betul, bukan? Saya mahu mendengarnya sekali lagi sahaja sebelum tidur.
messages.zh: 对吧？我想睡前再听一遍。
messages.en: Right? I just want to hear it once more before bed.

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries preserve two connected meanings in this word family: magical enchantment and powerful attraction. That connection offers a useful semantic picture: a beautiful voice can hold attention as though it casts a spell. This explains the relationship between the recorded senses without establishing which meaning developed first or asserting an unverified borrowing history. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=Mempesona)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pesona 是魅力；mempesona 把魅力施展出来，使人着迷；terpesona 是自己已经被迷住。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 适合赞美表演、声音和景色。对不熟悉的人直接评价外貌，可能显得过于私人；职场中赞美作品或表现更稳妥。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 普通赞美采用“吸引、迷人”义即可；涉及施咒的义项应有明确故事背景，避免据此指控现实中的个人。
